result:
All 14 queries ran and returned plausible answers. I checked AA14 by hand against sales.csv (north 44.9, south 52.3, east 10). AA11 returned `false`, which I didn't check by hand.

Where the language gives a map keyword keys, the output shows customers, paths and logins as keywords such as `:acme`. That applies to AA5, AA9 and AA14. In AA6, AA7, AA12 and AA13 I converted names to strings with `toString`, because the tasks ask for strings.

AA1: get /data/users | filter ~(allOf (get /active | eq true) ~(get /role | lower | anyOf (eq "admin") (eq "editor"))) | count
AA2: get /data/users | map ~(query /profile/country null) | filter ~(ne null) | map ~(lower) | distinct | sort
AA3: get /data/users | filter ~(allOf (get /active | eq true) ~(query /profile/age null | tag | eq ::number)) | map /profile/age | avg | round 1
AA4: filter ~(get /status | lower | eq "paid") | map ~(get /items | map ~(mulOf /qty /price) | sum) | sum | round 2
AA5: filter ~(get /status | lower | ne "cancelled") | groupBy /customer | map ~(count)
AA6: filter ~(get /status | lower | ne "cancelled") | groupBy /customer | map ~(map ~(get /items | map ~(mulOf /qty /price) | sum) | sum | round 2) | entries | map ~(get {:customer ~(get /0 | toString) :total /1}) | sort ~(get /total | desc) | take 2
AA7: get [/dependencies /devDependencies] | map ~(entries) | flat | filter ~(get /1 | startsWith "^") | map ~(get /0 | toString) | sort
AA8: "Red, green ,BLUE,green, red ,yellow, Blue" | split "," | map ~(trim | lower) | distinct | join "|"
AA9: filter ~(get /state | eq "open") | groupBy ~(query /assignee/login "unassigned") | map ~(count)
AA10: filter ~(get /state | eq "open") | sort ~(get /comments | desc) | take 3 | map /title
AA11: filter ~(allOf (get /state | eq "open") ~(get /labels | map ~(lower) | contains "bug")) | every ~(get /assignee | ne null)
AA12: get /services | entries | filter ~(allOf (get /1 | has /port) ~(get /1/port | ne null) ~(get /1 | query /enabled null | ne false)) | sort ~(get /1/port) | map ~(get [/0 ~(get /1/port | toString)] | join ":")
AA13: lines | map ~(split " ") | groupBy /2 | map ~(count) | entries | map ~(get {:path ~(get /0 | toString) :count /1}) | sort ~(get [~(get /count | desc) /path]) | take 2
AA14: lines | drop 1 | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(allOf (get /2 | ne "") (get /3 | ne "") ~(get /2 | toNumber | ne 0)) | groupBy ~(get /0 | trim | lower) | map ~(map ~(get [~(get /2 | toNumber) ~(get /3 | toNumber)] | reduce 1 ~(mul)) | sum | round 2)
